title: Rock in Rio 2026
metaDescription: Rock in Rio returns to Cidade do Rock in Rio de Janeiro on 4–7 and 11–13 September 2026 for seven days of live music.

overview.about: Rock in Rio is one of the largest music festivals in the world, first staged in Rio de Janeiro in 1985 and since exported to Lisbon, Madrid and beyond. Its huge 'City of Rock' site hosts global headliners across rock, pop and electronic music over multiple weekends.
overview.nextEvent: The next Rock in Rio is staged across multiple weekends at the purpose-built City of Rock in Rio de Janeiro. Several stages host international headliners and Brazilian stars, drawing crowds of many hundreds of thousands over the run.
